result_text:
`all_files.zip` now packages the scope file lists under names derived from the configured aspect names, so renaming `buildAndDeployment` no longer drops it or `git-history.zip`. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or a renamed-aspect export.

In `reports/.../dataexporters/DataExporter.java`, the zip step used to read five hard-coded files, such as `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`. It now takes the main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects in that order. For each one it gets the file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call that wrote the loose text files. It then reads that file and adds it to the zip under the same name.

With the default configuration the entries are the same five names in the same order. With the renamed aspect, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`, and `git-history.zip` is written whenever a `git-history.txt` exists.
